An den Ober Appellations Senat des Kammergerichtes.

Friedrich Wilhelm König p.

Unsern p. Da die Klage des Vormundes der Minorennen durch das Posensche Vormundschafts-Collegium veranlaßt, auch unter dessen Direction der Proceß selbst betrieben worden und ferner betrieben werden wird, die meiſten Räthe der Posener Regierung aber Mitglieder dieses Collegii sind; so haben Wir resolvirt, daß die benannte Rechts-Sache in erster Instanz von dem Pleno der Regierung zu Warschau, und in zweyter Instanz von Euch abgeurthelt werden soll; welches Wir Euch, und daß solcherhalb das Nötige an die Regierungen in Posen und Warschau erlassen worden, zur Nachricht und Achtung hierdurch bekannt machen.

Sind p. Berlin, den 7. December 1800. Ad mandatum

Berlin, 7 December 1800. To the South Prussian Government at Poznań.

ex officio

Friedrich Wilhelm, King, etc. Our, etc. Since most of the councillors of your court are members of the guardianship board there, and the suit of the guardian of the minor Michaelina von Prusimska against the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen for the recovery of the Brzyce estates was brought at the instance of the latter, and the lawsuit itself has been conducted, and will continue to be conducted, under its direction, We have found it necessary hereby to order that the said case shall be decided in the first instance by the full bench of the Government at Warsaw, and in the second instance by the Superior Appeal Senate of the Kammergericht. We hereby make this known to you for your information and observance, together with the fact that the necessary orders have accordingly been sent today to both the said courts; and are, etc. Berlin, 7 December 1800. By command.

# # #

To the South Prussian Government at Warsaw.

13th: all by post, and with the contents: md Bamg[text lost]t

11th Schroener

10 Dec. Friedrich Wilhelm, King, etc. Our, etc. A lawsuit is pending before the Poznań Government between the guardian of the minor Michaelina von Prusimska and the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, directed to the recovery of the Brzyce estates. Since the suit of the guardian of von Prusimska

was brought at the instance of the guardianship board there, and the lawsuit itself has been conducted, and will continue to be conducted, under its direction, but most of the councillors of the Poznań Government are members of the said board, We have resolved that the said case shall be decided in the first instance by the full bench of your court; which, and that the Government at Poznań

of this

has been informed, We hereby make known to you for your observance.

And are, etc. Berlin, 7 December 1800. By command.

# # #

To the Superior Appeal Senate of the Kammergericht.

Friedrich Wilhelm, King, etc.

Our, etc. A lawsuit is pending before the Poznań Government between the minor Michaelina von Prusimska and the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, directed to the recovery of the Brzyce estates. Since the suit of the minor's guardian was brought at the instance of the Poznań guardianship board, and the lawsuit itself has been conducted, and will continue to be conducted, under its direction, but most of the councillors of the Poznań Government are members of this board, We have resolved that the said case shall be decided in the first instance by the full bench of the Government at Warsaw, and in the second instance by you; which We hereby make known to you for your information and observance, together with the fact that the necessary orders have accordingly been sent to the Governments at Poznań and Warsaw.

And are, etc. Berlin, 7 December 1800. By command

G[oldbeck]

acc. the 3rd.

ad red. the 8th.

summary_en: On 7 December 1800 three rescripts in the King's name were drafted to take the suit of Michalina von Prusimska's guardian against the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen for the Brzyce estates away from Poznań. To the Government at Poznań: most of its councillors are members of the guardianship board there, which occasioned and directs the suit; the case will therefore be decided in the first instance by the full bench of the Government at Warsaw and in the second by the Senate of Higher Appeal of the Kammergericht, and both courts have been instructed the same day. To the Government at Warsaw: since the Poznań councillors mostly belong to that board, the case is to be decided in the first instance by its full bench, and the Government at Poznań has been informed. To the Senate of Higher Appeal of the Kammergericht: the case is to be decided in the first instance by the full bench of the Government at Warsaw and in the second by the Senate, and the Governments at Poznań and Warsaw have been instructed. The rescripts went to the post on the 13th.
summary_de: Drei Entwürfe königlicher Reskripte vom 7. Dezember 1800, einer nach dem anderen. Der erste, an die Regierung zu Posen: Die meisten ihrer Räte sind Mitglieder des dortigen Vormundschaftskollegiums, das die Klage des Vormunds der Michalina von Prusimska gegen den Fürsten von Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen auf Herausgabe der Brzycer Güter veranlasst hat und leitet. Deshalb wird festgesetzt, dass die Sache in erster Instanz vom Plenum der Regierung zu Warschau und in zweiter vom Oberappellationssenat des Kammergerichts entschieden wird. Beide Kollegien sind am selben Tag angewiesen worden. Der zweite, an die Regierung zu Warschau: Bei der Posener Regierung schwebt zwischen dem Vormund der minderjährigen Michalina von Prusimska und dem Fürsten von Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen ein Prozess auf Herausgabe der Brzycer Güter. Da das dortige Pupillenkollegium die Klage veranlasst hat und leitet und die meisten Posener Räte ihm angehören, soll die Sache in erster Instanz vom Plenum der Regierung zu Warschau entschieden werden. Die Regierung zu Posen ist benachrichtigt. Die Reskripte gingen am 13. zur Post. Der dritte, an den Oberappellationssenat des Kammergerichts: Die Sache soll in erster Instanz vom Plenum der Regierung zu Warschau und in zweiter Instanz vom Senat entschieden werden. Die Regierungen in Posen und Warschau sind angewiesen.
